summary: Tested Family World Cup 2026 backend (18 pytest tests, all passing after one bug fix) and frontend smoke flow (login + tournament page). Fixed one backend 500 error in /api/auth/register. Frontend login, dashboard, bottom-nav visibility, and Tournament Prediction page all confirmed working.

minor.issue: Returned 500 (ObjectId not iterable) because user dict still contained Mongo _id after insert_one. FIXED by adding user.pop('_id', None) (mirrors login). All 18 backend tests now pass.

ui_bugs.issue: Auto-test selector text='Matches'/'Board'/'Admin' matched dashboard headings ('Upcoming Matches', 'Leaderboard See Full Board', Admin top-right badge) instead of nav items. Recommend adding data-testid like nav-home/nav-matches/nav-board/nav-predict/nav-admin to bottom navigation links for reliable testing.
Sits on top of right-most bottom nav area on 390px viewport; may overlap Admin tap target slightly.

issues: Looks clean, mobile-first, flags render via react-country-flag correctly for Mexico/Poland/Ecuador/Senegal/England/Iran/USA/Wales/Argentina/Saudi Arabia

action_items: Add data-testid attributes to bottom navigation links (nav-home, nav-matches, nav-board, nav-predict, nav-admin) so automation can navigate without ambiguous text matches.
Consider running recompute_live_points once after server startup so leaderboard reflects existing results if any.
Group A 'Mexico B' and other duplicate-with-suffix names look like placeholder seed data — confirm intentional or replace with real 2026 qualifiers.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py /auth/register did not strip Mongo _id from response (now fixed). Same pattern should be reviewed for any future POST handlers that return inserted docs.
/api/matches GET returns kickoff as raw string; consider consistent ISO format with timezone for client parsing.
JWT_SECRET is read via os.environ[...] which will crash on missing env — OK for fail-fast but make sure deploy env always sets it.
Tournament prediction model: r32 declared but not used in current UI flow; clarify or remove.

set_auth_cookie uses samesite=none + secure=true (correct for cross-site), but frontend also stores token in localStorage and sends Bearer — duplication is fine, just be aware logout clears cookie only.

success_rate.frontend: ~70% (login + dashboard + tournament confirmed; matches/board/admin pages not exhaustively walked due to selector ambiguity, but admin endpoints fully verified via backend tests)

seed_data_creation: Tests create transient invited user (cleaned up in test_cleanup), one past-kickoff match (cleaned up), one finished match for scoring verification (cleaned up).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test suite at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py covers full auth/invite/teams/matches/predictions/scoring/leaderboard/tournament/admin flows and runs in <5s. Run: pytest /app/backend/tests/ -v. For frontend automation prefer data-testids on bottom nav (currently missing) and use page.goto(/matches), /leaderboard, /tournament, /admin direct URLs as a workaround.
rca of the issue: POST /api/auth/register: After db.users.insert_one(user), Motor mutates the in-place dict adding _id (bson.ObjectId). The handler popped password_hash but not _id, so FastAPI's jsonable_encoder tried to iterate ObjectId and raised TypeError -> 500. Fix: user.pop('_id', None) before return, matching existing /auth/login handler. Verified by re-running pytest – test_admin_invite_then_register now passes.
